name: patch source
about: The Pocket core's Scum! cheats as switches a player turns on and off while the game runs (tool/patchsrc.py, format 2). The same sites, words and bits as the Pocket core's table (its menu entry Little-Man, values 1 Health, 2 Pills, 4 Lives), with the switch point where the Pocket core takes a new setting. Every site is checked against the player's ROM by a hash, and the instructions the health cave runs again are read from that ROM when the game is translated.

switches.name: health
switches.about: Players take no damage, and a player's throws do no damage to enemies, as on the Pocket.

switches.name: pills
switches.about: Using a Blu pill (Down + A) does not spend one.

switches.name: lives
switches.about: Dying does not spend a life.

hooks.about: The compare of an object's damage with its health: the health cave gives player objects zero damage, then runs the compare.
The health write of the game's throw-damage routine, which only throws and thrown bodies use.
The decrement of the player's Blu pill count.
The decrement of the player's life count.
The last instruction of the game's pad read, once a frame in play: no switch's way can be running there.

words.name: arcade_stage
words.about: The stage the arcade mode of the game starts on, which the game reads when it starts; the ROM holds 1. The program sets it (targets/pc/pc_scum.c).

caves.name: health
caves.about: In zero padding before the animation data, which the game never reads. For a player object (slots 1 up to the game's own player count) the damage in d3 becomes zero; then the two instructions the hook left out, then rts.
